settings_subtitle: Your state, learning habits, reminders, and data.
settings_state_hint: Your progress stays. Only the 10 questions about your state change.
settings_translation_language_hint: Used when you translate a question
settings_session_size_hint: How many questions one practice session has
settings_confirm_answers_hint: Pick an answer, then tap “Check”. Off: instant feedback.
settings_auto_advance_hint: Move on automatically after a correct answer
settings_haptics_hint: Short vibration for correct and wrong answers
settings_exam_date_hint: For a countdown and reminders before the exam
settings_exam_date_past: This date is in the past. Clear it or pick a new one.
settings_section_streak_hint: Decide what keeps your streak alive.
settings_streak_rule: What counts as a streak day
settings_rest_days_hint: Days off that never break your streak
settings_freezes_hint: Every 7 days in a row you earn a freeze (up to {max}). A freeze covers a missed day automatically.
settings_notifications_web: Reminders on your phone are only available in the Android app. In-app notifications under the bell icon work here too.
settings_permission_denied_help: Notifications are blocked for this app. Allow them in your Android settings under Apps → Leben in Deutschland → Notifications, then come back.
settings_reminder_daily_hint: Sometimes a question of the day, sometimes a look at your progress
settings_reminder_streak_hint: In the evening, when today does not count yet
settings_reminder_exam_hint: 30, 14, 7, 3, and 1 day before your exam, and on the day
settings_reminder_exam_no_date: Add an exam date above to get these
settings_reminder_mock_hint: When you have not taken one for a while
settings_test_notification_sent: Coming in 5 seconds. Watch your notification bar.
settings_test_notification_failed: Could not send a test notification. Check that notifications are allowed.
settings_tips_hint: A study tip in the notification center every week
settings_inbox_note: Reached goals, streak milestones, achievements, and the exam countdown always appear under the bell icon.
settings_export_hint: Save your progress as a file
settings_import_hint: Replaces your current progress with the file
settings_import_denied_help: Allow file access for this app in your Android settings to import a backup.
settings_msg_invalid: This file is not a backup from this app
settings_msg_nothing: There is nothing to export yet
settings_start_over_hint: Delete your progress and begin again
settings_start_over_removes: This deletes your answers, mock exams, daily history, review schedule, achievements, streak, and notifications.
settings_start_over_keeps: Your federal state, language, settings, and exam date stay.
settings_credits: Questions from the official catalogue of the BAMF. This app is not affiliated with the BAMF.
settings_support_text: The app is free and has no ads. If it helps you, you can say thanks with a small tip.
settings_support_thanked_one: You have tipped {count} time. Thank you!
settings_support_thanked_other: You have tipped {count} times. Thank you!
settings_support_pending: Your payment is still being checked. The tip is counted once Google Play confirms it.
settings_support_failed: That did not work. Please try again later.
settings_support_via_play: Tips are processed securely by Google Play and unlock nothing. The app stays the same for everyone.
